protocol.name: BBBC001v1: StarDist full-chain test with fresh vanilla and Astra+StarDist ablation
protocol.working_tree: Inference changes committed before live evaluation
protocol.selection: All six published images, in annotation-file order; no exclusions.
protocol.split_note: BBBC001 has no official train/test split. 'test' is a local Harbor routing label only.
protocol.task: Published cell-counting task; identical neutral instruction for every image and mode.
protocol.primary_metric: Mean over all six images of 100 * abs(prediction - mean(two human counts)) / mean(two human counts); lower is better.
protocol.missing_policy: No official full-dataset score if any prediction is missing, negative, nonfinite or an error. Show coverage and answered-subset error separately; do not rank partial scores against complete scores.
protocol.preprocessing: Same losslessly replicated grayscale PNG for all modes. StarDist normalizes intensities at percentiles 1/99.8 inside its tool; default/sensitive/conservative threshold profiles are fixed in code. Crops are traceable. No benchmark-specific segmentation tuning.
protocol.leakage: Only PNG and question enter the agent environment; counts, original filenames, source URLs and dataset metadata stay in verifier/report. Prior model exposure to this public dataset cannot be ruled out.
limitations: Six previously inspected development images, not a held-out sample.
Prior pretraining exposure to public microscopy images cannot be ruled out.
Human counts disagree; their mean is the scoring reference.
One attempt per mode; stochastic baseline variation remains.
Full chain retains Jev selection and all five review requirements at 0.75 with bounded replanning; abstentions do not earn a full-dataset score.
Jev sees structured evidence summaries, not image pixels. Astra receives originals and selected overlays/crops.
Threshold profiles use the same model and do not constitute independent corroboration.
Count labels alone cannot establish mask precision/recall.
Standalone baseline is a deterministic default-tool control, reproduced inside the specialist container; new harness modes use independent Astra plans.
First and last candidate counts will be scored separately from accepted final answers; no best-of-N selection.

protocol.attribution: BBBC001v1, Moffat et al. (Cell, 2006), Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection; Ljosa et al. (Nature Methods, 2012).
protocol.user_scope: Replace OpenCV segmentation with StarDist and evaluate the entire selection/review/replanning chain; include fresh vanilla/tools controls and standalone default baseline.
protocol.prior_exposure: All six images were inspected in previous experiments. This is another complete-cohort retest, not fresh held-out evaluation.

mode_labels.full: Full harness: Astra + StarDist + Jev selection/review loop

answer.explanation: The default full-image StarDist label map contains exactly 349 distinct positive nucleus-instance IDs, including border instances. This would estimate 349 cells under a one-nucleus-per-cell assumption, without correction or averaging. However, the requested segmentation-applicability and target-validity checks remain unresolved; no additional measurement tools are available here to resolve them.
